source.title: USDA Table of Nutrient Retention Factors, Release 6
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service, Nutrient Data Laboratory
source.note: Percent of the nutrient retained (true retention, nearest 5 %), for the nutrients the app tracks that the table covers. Vitamin A is the table's "Vitamin A, RE". Nutrients the table does not cover (energy, macronutrients, fiber, sugars, saturated fat, vitamin D) have no factor.
